intro: Three things I take on for clients: building the website, finding out whether anyone actually wants the product, and doing the science. Most work starts with a conversation.

services.title: Web development
services.teaser: Sites and small web apps, designed and built end to end.
services.detail: From a one-page launch site to a full content-driven site you can update yourself. I handle the design, the build, the deployment, and the unglamorous parts — speed, accessibility, and making sure it still works on a four-year-old phone.
includes: Design and build, from blank page to live site
A built-in editor so you can change content without touching code
Fast, accessible, and search-friendly by default
Domain, deployment, and analytics set up for you

services.title: Customer discovery
services.teaser: Structured interviews for early-stage startups, before you commit engineering time.
services.detail: I design the interview plan, run the conversations, and turn them into findings you can act on. The point is to hear what people actually do rather than what they say they would do — including the answers that are inconvenient for the roadmap.
includes: Interview guide, screening criteria, and recruiting
Conversations run by someone who isn't selling to them
Synthesis into themes, verbatim quotes, and jobs to be done
A clear read on what to build next, and what to drop

services.title: Scientific research
services.teaser: Literature synthesis, study design, and analysis across biotech and health.
services.detail: Research support at whatever depth you need: framing the question, designing the study, running the analysis, and writing it up for the people who have to approve it. Past work spans RNA-seq pipelines, survival models on Medicare claims, BCI signal processing, and molecular dynamics.
includes: Grant sections, reports, and publication-ready figures

process.title: Intro conversation
process.body: Share context, timeline, and what success looks like. No commitment required.

process.title: Scope & quote
process.body: I send a short scope doc with deliverables, timeline, and fixed or hourly pricing.

process.title: Delivery
process.body: Work in agreed checkpoints. You get drafts early; we refine before final handoff.

cta_body_contact: Use the contact form below — I reply by email, usually within a few days. Projects are scoped and invoiced after we talk.
cta_body_stripe: Use the contact form for custom scope, or pay for a defined offering via Stripe when you are ready.
cta_body_linkedin: Reach me on LinkedIn and tell me a little about the work. I reply within a few days. Projects are scoped and invoiced after we talk.
